description: Behavioural evals for the skill-writing skill: does an agent that loads it produce a valid, concise, well-routed skill, and does it trigger at the right time?

evals.label: Write an EPANET .inp parser skill
evals.prompt: Create a skill that parses EPANET .inp files and emits a JSON summary of nodes, links, and demands.
evals.expected_output: A new skill directory whose SKILL.md has valid frontmatter, a routing description, a concise procedure under 500 lines, and passes `agentskills validate`.
assertions: The description states what the skill does and when to use it, not the workflow steps.
The body omits generic Agent Skills knowledge the agent already has.

evals.label: Improve a poorly written skill without breaking it
evals.prompt: The skill in bad-skill/ has a missing description and a bloated, generic body. Rewrite its SKILL.md so it validates and follows the format, keeping the original name and file references.
evals.expected_output: A rewritten bad-skill/SKILL.md whose name still matches its directory, with a routing description, a concise procedure, and valid frontmatter.

evals.label: Triggers when asked to author a skill
evals.prompt: Create a skill that converts WNTR simulation results to CSV.
evals.expected_output: The agent loads skill-writing before writing anything, and does not load unrelated skills.

evals.label: Does not trigger on unrelated work
evals.prompt: Explain the difference between laminar and turbulent flow in a pipe.
evals.expected_output: The agent answers the question directly without loading skill-writing.
